scope: Independent reading of both complete immutable candidates: stems, all six alternatives, keys, explanations and distractor rationales, with recomputed exact fingerprints. This is a semantic-duplication decision, not technical-source approval or a final question attestation.
finding: The same core parameter-binding decision is sufficient to answer both exact option sets.
sharedDecision: Send externally supplied text as a separate driver parameter rather than constructing SQL text with concatenation or marker replacement before executing the query.
reasoning: Both stems expressly require separating a caller value containing quotes from query structure.
Cosmos A and psycopg C are each the only choice that passes the value through a separate parameter argument.
Cosmos B and psycopg A both insert the caller value by concatenating the SQL string before execution.
Cosmos C and psycopg B both consume placeholder-looking text through host-side substitution before the database driver receives the query.

The APIs genuinely differ: Cosmos uses named name/value entries, and psycopg uses an unquoted placeholder plus a positional tuple. At these hashes, however, neither option set requires a second independent interface rule beyond identifying the only separate-value channel. Different API spelling and a concrete Python example do not justify counting the same decision twice.

recommendation.preferenceReason: Its complete executable Python calls make the driver-versus-Python-formatting distinction more concrete. Both IDs already have historical identities, so this is a preference for the authored exercise, not a claim that an older ID automatically passes.
recommendation.ai200-d-003: Keep excluded unless its original author creates a genuinely different grounded decision and all three passes are completed again for the new exact content.
recommendation.boundary: This is not a rule that every parameterized-query question across different SDKs is a duplicate. A genuinely different binding limitation, input category, or required API contract can support another independently discriminating question.
recommendation.noApprovalGranted: The selected representative still requires the real independent adversarial review and all ordinary technical/source/rubric/freshness gates. Preserve prior manual reviews and immutable snapshots; do not fabricate a final rejection attestation or change only concept labels.
